Share intents are the services' public share URLs for the post's canonical URL. The markup does not say whether the three meta spans are separated; one space is drawn between them. The contract has no site key for showing the breadcrumb, byline, share or author box; each is drawn here because the document supplies its data.

document.title: Feeding your soil, not your plants

author.name: Priya Shah
author.bio: Priya has run the kitchen garden at Hollin Farm for eleven years and writes about soil, water and patience.

document.body:
Most gardeners reach for a bottle of feed the moment leaves turn pale. The soil is usually the better place to start.

Why compost does the heavy lifting

A well-rotted mulch feeds the organisms that feed your plants, and it holds water through a dry spell.

Spread it two inches deep each autumn and leave the worms to do the digging. See our guide to hedge laying for the other end of the garden.

older.title: A beginner's guide to hedge laying
